description: Watch Together Live Sync hardening (WP-INFRA-28 Part A, backlog wp-infra-28b): unguessable room codes (6 characters of a 28-character alphabet from crypto.getRandomValues), a cap of 20 connections on the host, and a check of every message a guest receives (only goto, an integer moment 1..675, a note of at most 280 characters). Parameter set: later set: WP-PAGEC-15 (note of at most 280 characters) and WP-PAGEC-17 (28-character alphabet, about 481 million codes); selected by row C08.

patches.find: shares a 5-letter code; anyone who enters it sees the same moment move on their own screen in real time.
patches.repl: shares a 6-character code; anyone who enters it sees the same moment move on their own screen as the host plays or jumps.
patches.note: Live Sync sentence (line 126): the code length, and "in real time" goes (REALTIME hit of line 126). The other REALTIME hit (the span after "Share this code") is wp-content-09b.
join input (line 160): a code of the new length can be typed
randomCode (lines 298-303): constants, crypto.getRandomValues code, message check parseGoto, host message hostMessage

patches.find: connections.forEach(c => { if (c.open) { try { c.send({ type: 'goto', tick, note }); } catch (e) {} } });
patches.repl: connections.forEach(c => { if (c.open) { try { c.send(hostMessage(tick, note)); } catch (e) {} } });
patches.note: host broadcast (line 295): the message goes through hostMessage

patches.repl:
let code;
    try { code = randomCode(); } catch (e) { setSyncStatus('could not make a safe session code in this browser', 'error'); return; }
patches.note: startHost (line 346): without crypto.getRandomValues no session starts and the status says so
host connection cap (lines 354-355): connections beyond maxGuests are closed and never added to the list

patches.find: if (currentTick != null) conn.send({ type: 'goto', tick: currentTick, note: currentNote });
patches.note: late joiner snapshot (line 358): same message check as the broadcast

patches.find: if (code.length !== 5) { setSyncStatus('enter the 5-letter code first', 'error'); return; }
patches.repl: if (code.length !== WT.codeLength) { setSyncStatus('enter the ' + WT.codeLength + '-character code first', 'error'); return; }
patches.note: join check (line 370): the code length and its message
guest handler (lines 384-386): conn.on("data") passes only a validated message to goToTick
